ears_text: The system shall propagate a hotfix to the integration branch by merge and shall not propagate a hotfix to the integration branch by cherry-pick.
notes: Same as `back-merge-no-ff`: scans project source and docs for the word "cherry-pick". Weak proxy; review or drop. Gate point set 2026-09-22 at the user's request; same weak-proxy caveat as back-merge-no-ff.
